mintAuthority.summary: syrupUSDT is Maple's ERC-4626 strategy-vault receipt for USDT lent to institutional borrowers; shares are minted against USDT deposits and do not create base USDT supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDT (usdt-tether). The vault token is an immutable non-proxy contract with no upgrade path.

controls.label: Maple syrupUSDT ERC-4626 vault token
controls.capDescription: syrupUSDT shares are minted/burned by the Maple ERC-4626 vault against USDT deposits and FIFO-queued withdrawals; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDT supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800 (2026-10-01), name() is Syrup USDT, symbol() is syrupUSDT, decimals() is 6 and asset() is USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. Correct EIP-1967 implementation, admin (0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103) and beacon slots are zero; deployed bytecode is 11660 bytes; owner() and admin() revert. The Pool token is immutable, but manager() is 0x0cda32e08b48bfddbc7ee96b44b09cf286f9e21a, whose implementation() is 0xfe02be1ad28edfd8e3dd6f29c402b244c2a258b8 and factory() is 0xe463cd473ecc1d1a4ecf20b62624d84dd20a8339. Maple documents state-changing Pool calls as gated by PoolManager.canCall; token immutability does not establish immutable protocol permissions.

controls.label: Inherited USDT (Tether) issuer mint path
controls.capDescription: The verified USDT implementation lets the current owner call issue(uint256) to increase total supply without an on-chain numeric ceiling; the binding limit is Tether's off-chain issuance and reserve process.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25584916 (2026-07-22T01:14:23Z), USDT getOwner() resolves to this 3-of-6 multisig-style owner. Tether's verified implementation exposes owner-only issue(uint256), which adds the requested amount to total supply without checking a fixed numeric cap; syrupUSDT shares inherit that base-asset authority.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), the verified MaplePool runtime matches the canonical token deployment. deposit/mint and their permit variants exclusively enter the internal _mint(shares, assets, receiver, caller), which requires nonzero assets and a successful transferFrom of the underlying from the caller; bootstrap shares also arise only within that deposit transaction. No external arbitrary-share mint or share-minter authorization exists. PoolManager permissions, liquidity limits and asset-accounting parameters do not remove the deposited-asset transfer requirement. Manager upgrade power remains the separately recorded upgrade dimension, not a D14 mint trigger. Inherited issuer controls describe parent issuance carried by the serial-claim dependency edge, not wrapper-local share minting; parent D14 risk is not charged twice.

review.evidence: syrupUSDT (variantOf usdt-tether, variantKind strategy-vault) is a Maple lending-vault receipt whose shares track deposited USDT and cannot create base USDT. The immutable wrapper result remains supported by zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots and non-proxy bytecode. At Ethereum block 25584916, the inherited USDT authority resolves to Tether's 3-of-6 owner; the verified owner-only issue(uint256) path can increase supply without a numeric contract ceiling. The Network Firm dashboard last verified 2026-09-29 at 01:00 UTC explicitly covers combined syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT loan collateral. Maple's May 7 announcement describes custodian-sourced collateral value and approved-custodian procedures, with loan-book collateralization marked coming soon. Neither source establishes exact syrupUSDT reserve-to-token-liability reconciliation, so the previous periodic label is withdrawn to unknown under owner ruling D22. This does not assert that internal checks stopped or change the inherited Tether mint path. Historical economic-posture review of 2026-08-15 is retained here. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03: At Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), the verified MaplePool runtime matches the canonical token deployment. deposit/mint and their permit variants exclusively enter the internal _mint(shares, assets, receiver, caller), which requires nonzero assets and a successful transferFrom of the underlying from the caller; bootstrap shares also arise only within that deposit transaction. No external arbitrary-share mint or share-minter authorization exists. PoolManager permissions, liquidity limits and asset-accounting parameters do not remove the deposited-asset transfer requirement. Manager upgrade power remains the separately recorded upgrade dimension, not a D14 mint trigger. Inherited issuer controls describe parent issuance carried by the serial-claim dependency edge, not wrapper-local share minting; parent D14 risk is not charged twice.
